title: Refactor endpoint to reuse the existing budget service
description: The new `GET /api/codex/issues/{id}/budget` endpoint in `backend/app/interfaces/api.py` currently duplicates the spent-aggregation and budget-resolution logic instead of calling `compute_issue_budget_status` from `app.application.budget_service`. Refactor the endpoint to delegate to `compute_issue_budget_status(codex_store, issue)` and return `status.to_dict()`. The endpoint must keep the 404-on-missing-issue behavior. The behaviour must be byte-identical (same fields, same field types) — this is a refactor, not a feature change. Existing tests for the endpoint must continue to pass unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint calls compute_issue_budget_status instead of inlining aggregation
Response shape is identical to the pre-refactor version

pinned_qa_commands.description: Existing budget endpoint tests must still pass

argv: from pathlib import Path; text = Path('app/interfaces/api.py').read_text(); assert 'from app.application.budget_service' in text
pinned_qa_commands.description: Endpoint imports and uses the shared budget service

notes: Refactor should not change the wire shape. If any test fails because the shape drifted, the refactor is incomplete.
